V1.verbatim: Review, improve, and develop the Platform, including by monitoring interactions and usage across your devices, analysing how people are using it, and by training, testing, and improving our technology, such as our machine learning models and algorithms.
V1.onde: Doc 1, seção "How We Use Your Information", item da lista de finalidades
V1.por_que: Única menção a "testing" no registro vinculante; testar é de tecnologia/modelos, sem nomear grupos, variantes ou aleatorização — material para decidir entre 1 e 2 no registro vinculante.

V1.verbatim: We use the information we have to understand how people are using the Platform and to develop, test, and make improvements to the Platform, including to develop and improve our technology, such as our machine learning models and algorithms.
V1.onde: Doc 1, seção "Legitimate Interests", subitem "Review, improve, promote, and develop the Platform"
V1.por_que: Repete "test" ligado a melhoria do serviço na base legal; ainda sem método nomeado.

V1.verbatim: We also use the information obtained through these cookies to test design ideas.
V1.onde: Doc 3, Cookies Policy, seção "Analytics and research"
V1.por_que: "Test design ideas" sugere testar sobre usuários (nível 2), sem nomear A/B ou grupos.

V1.verbatim: That's why we're testing ways to avoid recommending a series of similar content – such as around extreme dieting or fitness, sadness, or breakups – to protect against viewing too much of a content category that may be fine as a single video but problematic if viewed in clusters.
V1.por_que: Reconhecimento explícito de testar sobre usuários em produção, em registro não-vinculante, sem nomear método (candidato a 2).

V1.verbatim: Split testing in TikTok Ads Manager allows you to test two different versions of your ads to determine which one performs best.
V1.onde: Doc 5, Business Help Centre, parágrafo de abertura
V1.por_que: Nomeia split testing; porém a ferramenta é oferecida a anunciantes — evaluator precisa decidir se conta como experimentação sobre usuários.

V1.verbatim: You can use split tests to keep the other variables the same and split your audience into two equal groups, with each group seeing only one ad group in order to draw a statistical conclusion about your ad performance and optimize future campaigns.
V1.por_que: Descreve divisão da audiência em grupos com variantes distintas — critério literal do nível 3 (variantes servidas a usuários distintos).

V1.verbatim: Split testing is scientifically designed to perform an accurate A/B test with a 90% confidence rate to determine which ad group performs better.
V1.onde: Doc 5, seção "Benefits", bullet "Learn from accurate and statistically significant results"
V1.por_que: Nomeia "A/B test" explicitamente — teto potencial 3, localizado fora dos documentos contratuais ao usuário.

V1.verbatim: changes we make to the Platform in the usual course of developing our product;
V1.por_que: Mostra que o ToS (vinculante) só fala em desenvolver/alterar o produto, sem qualquer linguagem de teste — evidência do nível do registro vinculante sozinho.

V2.verbatim: We use your information to operate, provide, develop, and improve the Platform, including for the following purposes.
V2.onde: Doc 1, abertura de "How We Use Your Information"
V2.por_que: Enquadramento de service improvement no registro vinculante.

V2.verbatim: Facilitate research conducted by independent researchers that meets certain criteria.
V2.onde: Doc 1, lista de finalidades em "How We Use Your Information"

V2.verbatim: We share your information with independent researchers to facilitate research that meets certain criteria, including where such researchers have demonstrable experience and expertise in their area.
V2.por_que: Research envolvendo dados de usuários compartilhados com pesquisadores — relevante para human-subjects research.

V2.verbatim: Legitimate Interest relied upon : To facilitate independent research that aims to develop society’s collective knowledge, including in the areas of misinformation and disinformation, violence, cybercrime, and social trends.
V2.por_que: Co-ocorrência research + bem público ("society's collective knowledge").

V2.verbatim: We use your information to ensure the safety and well-being of our community, including by reviewing User Content
V2.onde: Doc 1, "Legitimate Interests", subitem "Ensure the safety and well-being of our community"
V2.por_que: Linguagem de bem-estar da comunidade — âncora do enquadramento social-good/community.

V2.verbatim: Our goal is to foster an environment where people feel safe and supported being exactly who they are, whether they're creating videos for our community or watching them.
V2.por_que: Enquadramento social-good/community no registro não-vinculante, justificando o trabalho de recomendação/teste.

V2.verbatim: This work is being informed by ongoing conversations with experts across medicine, clinical psychology, and AI ethics, members of our Content Advisory Council, and our community.
V2.por_que: Enquadramento de bem-estar/saúde mental associado aos testes de recomendação.

V2.verbatim: Developing and maintaining TikTok's recommendation system is a continuous process as we work to refine accuracy, adjust models, and reassess the factors and weights that contribute to recommendations based on feedback from users, research, and data.
V2.por_que: Co-ocorrência service improvement + research em registro não-vinculante.

V3.verbatim: Review, improve, and develop the Platform, including by monitoring interactions and usage across your devices, analysing how people are using it, and by training, testing, and improving our technology, such as our machine learning models and algorithms.
V3.por_que: V3a: nomeia superfície testada de forma genérica (tecnologia, modelos de machine learning e algoritmos).

V3.verbatim: We also use the information obtained through these cookies to test design ideas.
V3.por_que: V3a: "design ideas" como objeto de teste.

V3.verbatim: That's why we're testing ways to avoid recommending a series of similar content – such as around extreme dieting or fitness, sadness, or breakups – to protect against viewing too much of a content category that may be fine as a single video but problematic if viewed in clusters.
V3.por_que: V3b/V3c: alvo é a sequência de recomendação (ranking) e categorias de conteúdo com carga afetiva (sadness, breakups); descreve um teste em andamento.

V3.verbatim: For example, our systems won't recommend two videos in a row made by the same creator or with the same sound.
V3.por_que: Regra de ranking descrita como feature — útil para distinguir personalização declarada de alvo de experimento.

V3.verbatim: For example, we're working on a feature that would let people choose words or hashtags associated with content they don't want to see in their For You feed.
V3.onde: Doc 6, seção "A new way to shape what you see"
V3.por_que: V3c: feature específica em desenvolvimento; evaluator decide se "working on a feature" equivale a experimento ativo divulgado.

V3.verbatim: You can use split tests to keep the other variables the same and split your audience into two equal groups, with each group seeing only one ad group in order to draw a statistical conclusion about your ad performance and optimize future campaigns.
V3.por_que: V3a/V3b: variáveis testáveis explicitamente enumeradas no contexto de anúncios.

V3.onde: Doc 5, lista "You can test the following variables"
V3.por_que: V3-pricing: única menção próxima de preço é bidding de anunciante, não preço ao consumidor nem personalização de preço — evidência para provável "No".

V3.verbatim: All these factors are processed by our recommendation system and weighted based on their value to a user.
V3.onde: Doc 4, seção "What factors contribute to For You?"
V3.por_que: Descrição de personalização algorítmica como feature, não como alvo de experimento — contraste exigido pelo critério.

V4.verbatim: We may only use your information when we have a “legal basis” to do so. We use different legal bases depending on why we use your information (in other words, the “purpose” of our processing). These legal bases are contractual necessity, legitimate interests (ours, yours or those of another party), consent, compliance with a legal obligation, performing a task in the public interest, and protection of vital interests.
V4.onde: Doc 1, abertura de "Our Legal Bases and How We Process Your Information"
V4.por_que: Lista de bases legais disponíveis; nenhuma finalidade chamada "experimentação".

V4.verbatim: Review, improve, promote, and develop the Platform .
V4.por_que: Finalidade declarada que plausivelmente cobre experimentação (mapeamento "improve services").

V4.verbatim: Legitimate Interest relied upon : To improve, promote, and develop the Platform in an informed way.
V4.onde: Doc 1, "Legitimate Interests", subitem "Review, improve, promote, and develop the Platform"
V4.por_que: Base legal explícita (legitimate interest) atrelada à finalidade de testar/desenvolver a Plataforma.

V4.verbatim: If you have the legal capacity to enter into an enforceable contract, we use Information You Provide , Automatically Collected Information , and Information From Other Sources where it is necessary to perform the contract you enter into (our Terms) when you register for, access, or use the Platform.
V4.por_que: Base contratual cobre "Personalise features and content" (For You feed) — alternativa de mapeamento.

V4.verbatim: With your consent, we serve you personalised ads on the Platform based on your activity on and off the Platform.
V4.por_que: Consentimento aparece apenas para ads/pagamento/permissões de dispositivo, não para experimentação.

V4.verbatim: This privacy policy (" Privacy Policy ") applies to the personal information that TikTok processes in connection with TikTok apps, websites, software and related services (the “ Platform ”), that link to or reference this Privacy Policy.
V4.por_que: Documento é a versão EEA/UK/CH — evidência para avaliar region gating da tabela de bases legais.

V4.verbatim: (These terms apply if you live or have your principal place of business in the European Economic Area, Switzerland or the UK)
V4.por_que: Confirma que o conjunto documental analisado é o regionalizado para a UE/UK/CH.

V5.verbatim: Your Rights : Whenever we use your information on the basis that it is necessary for legitimate interests, you can object to, and request restriction of, such usage.
V5.por_que: Direito genérico de objeção do GDPR; é o único mecanismo que alcançaria a finalidade de melhorar/testar a Plataforma.

V5.verbatim: You also have the right to object to the processing of your information in certain circumstances. This right applies when we are performing a task in the public interest, pursuing our legitimate interests or those of a third party, or when your data is processed for the purpose of facilitating scientific or historical research in certain circumstances.
V5.onde: Doc 1, "Your Rights and Choices", item "Object to the processing of your information"
V5.por_que: Objeção inclui pesquisa científica, mas continua sendo direito genérico, sem controle dedicado a experimentos.

V5.verbatim: You can manage your cookie settings any time and accept or refuse optional cookies.
V5.por_que: Falso positivo clássico: controle de cookies (incl. analytics) não é opt-out de experimentação.

V5.verbatim: Some of the cookies that we use are essential to operate the Platform. As a result, you cannot control the use of such cookies.
V5.onde: Doc 3, seção "How can you control cookies?"
V5.por_que: Delimita o escopo do controle disponível — ads/medição/analytics, não experimentos.

V5.verbatim: We already enable people to tap any video and select "Not interested" to automatically skip future videos from that same creator or using the same audio.
V5.onde: Doc 6, seção "A new way to shape what you see"
V5.por_que: Controle de personalização do feed, não opt-out de participação em testes — evidência para descartar como dedicated.

V7.verbatim: We will give you reasonable advance notice of significant changes which will impact you and confirm the date they will come into force.
V7.onde: Doc 2, seção 7.1 "What happens when we make changes"
V7.por_que: Aviso de mudança de serviço — explicitamente excluído pelo critério como falso positivo de debriefing; nenhum aviso posterior de participação em experimento aparece em qualquer documento.

V7.verbatim: We may amend or update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes to this policy by a notice provided through the Platform or by other means.
V7.por_que: Aviso de alteração de política, não debriefing — registrado para documentar que o tema de notificação existe, mas nunca sobre experimentos.

V8.verbatim: This work is being informed by ongoing conversations with experts across medicine, clinical psychology, and AI ethics, members of our Content Advisory Council, and our community.
V8.por_que: Menção a ética (AI ethics) e a um conselho consultivo ligada ao trabalho de recomendação/testes; borderline — consulta, não revisão ética de experimentos, e em registro não-vinculante.

V8.verbatim: Our safety team takes additional precautions to review videos as they rise in popularity to reduce the likelihood of content that may not be appropriate for a general audience entering our recommended system.
V8.por_que: Revisão de conteúdo por equipe de segurança, não avaliação de risco de experimento — evidência para separar moderação de ética de pesquisa.

V8.verbatim: Note: At the TikTok Transparency Center in Los Angeles, invited experts will have the opportunity to learn how our algorithm operates along with reviewing TikTok source code, which will be made available at the center for testing and evaluation.
V8.por_que: Escrutínio externo do algoritmo por especialistas; avaliador decide se equivale a revisão/avaliação de risco de experimentos (provável No).

V8.verbatim: We maintain appropriate technical, administrative, and physical security measures that are designed to protect your information from unauthorised access, theft, disclosure, modification, or loss.
V8.por_que: Única linguagem de salvaguarda no registro vinculante é de segurança da informação — nenhuma menção a comitê, revisão ética ou avaliação de risco de experimentos.

V9.verbatim: This privacy policy (" Privacy Policy ") applies to the personal information that TikTok processes in connection with TikTok apps, websites, software and related services (the “ Platform ”), that link to or reference this Privacy Policy.
V9.por_que: Confirma o local "privacy policy" e sua função de documento de privacidade aplicável ao uso da Plataforma.

V9.verbatim: These Terms of Service and the other additional terms and policies which may apply to you (see Section 3) (“ Terms ”) contain the agreement between you and TikTok in respect of the Platform (defined below).
V9.por_que: Auto-declaração de que o documento é o acordo com o usuário — teste de registro vinculante do critério.

V9.verbatim: Learn more about the recommendation system and the tools you can use to customise your feed here (this information forms part of these Terms).
V9.onde: Doc 2, seção 4.1 "Our Platform and business model"
V9.por_que: Incorpora explicitamente a página sobre o sistema de recomendação ao contrato — decisivo para atribuir registro vinculante a material hospedado fora do ToS.

V9.verbatim: Information on how we use data we collect about you can be found in our Privacy Policy and Cookies Policy . These do not form part of these Terms but are important documents which we strongly recommend that you read.
V9.por_que: O próprio ToS declara que Privacy e Cookies Policy não fazem parte dos Termos — informação relevante (e contraintuitiva) para a decisão de registro.

V9.verbatim: This Cookies Policy explains how TikTok and our partners use cookies and similar technologies. It applies to TikTok’s apps, websites, software and related services (together, the “Platform”).
V9.por_que: Identifica o local "cookies policy" e seu escopo.

V9.verbatim:
About Split Testing | TikTok Ads Manager
Business Help Centre
V9.onde: Doc 5, título e cabeçalho da página
V9.por_que: Identifica o local como help centre de negócios (Ads Manager), não documento ao usuário consumidor.

V9.verbatim: How TikTok recommends videos #ForYou - Newsroom | TikTok
V9.por_que: Identifica o local blog/PR (Newsroom) — registro presumivelmente não-vinculante, salvo pela incorporação citada no Doc 2.

V9.verbatim: An update on our work to safeguard and diversify recommendations - Newsroom | TikTok
V9.por_que: Segundo local blog/PR onde vive o reconhecimento de testes sobre usuários.
